mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread on King main thrust bearings, with posters describing free-spread specification problems on 2024 and 2025 production and bearings that do not seat tightly.
mentions.replyNote: Readable today for the first time after months of 403s: no King or official reply, thread still open and unresolved, last post dated 3 June 2026.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Poster reports King STDX thrust bearings over 1mm too narrow to fit BMW S85 and S65 blocks and concludes King main bearings should not be used on those engines.
mentions.replyNote: Still 307-redirects to the tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning thread content; redirect not followed.

mentions.snippet: Complaint about a mis-sorted King bearing package (wrong mix of undersizes in an unopened set) and, more pointedly, about the support response to it.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: Buyer received a King SI main bearing shell malformed in production, crushed and twisted so it would not fit the block; also reports shaving material in the rod bearing packaging.
mentions.replyNote: Thread read successfully; no King or official brand representative has replied and it remains open and unresolved.

mentions.title: Just call it what it is---King Bearings are no longer an option....
mentions.snippet: Thread arguing King bearings are effectively unavailable for 6-bolt engines, described as on back-order since the COVID period. Availability complaint rather than a product fault.
